core_obligations: Part (1) (proof line 3831): immediate from the bound lemma.

Part (2) (proof lines 3833-3849): a proper birational morphism is finite and iso over a dense open, so after base change the geometric components correspond bijectively with isomorphic function fields, hence isomorphic nonsingular projective models and equal geometric genera.
Part (3) (proof lines 3850-3852): the normalization is birational over the reduction, so (1) and (2) compose to the equality.
proof_roadmap: Read off the reduction invariance from the bound lemma.
Compare geometric components and function fields across a birational modification.
Compose with the birationality of normalization for part (3).
